capabilities: Search the vault by semantic similarity
Combine exact matching with similarity-based phrase search
Highlight matched excerpts and jump to the source line
Open results in new tabs or insert links from the keyboard
Download language models for offline English and Japanese search
extras: Language models download automatically from GitHub Releases in the background (can be opted out of in settings); the listing notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's built-in search only matches literal text, so notes can't be found when the exact wording is forgotten.
summary: Local vector search plugin that finds passages by meaning beyond exact words, with highlighted excerpts, for English and Japanese.
